hero.subtitle: Expert electronics repair and maintenance — certified technicians, genuine parts, and fast turnaround for every device.

ourStory.paragraph1: Black Mamba was created to make discovering and buying electronics simple, reliable, and enjoyable—bringing the latest technology together in one trusted marketplace.
ourStory.paragraph2: Every product on Black Mamba is carefully selected, quality-checked, and sourced from trusted brands to ensure performance you can rely on. From everyday essentials to cutting-edge devices, we understand technology because it's part of how we live, work, and connect every day.

process.heading: How Our Electronics Service Works
process.description: Our electronics service center follows a proven process to ensure your devices are repaired efficiently with the highest quality standards and genuine components.

step1.title: Device Drop-off & Assessment
step1.description: Bring your device to our center or schedule a pickup for initial assessment.

step2.title: Diagnostics & Issue Detection
step2.description: Our technicians run comprehensive diagnostics to identify hardware and software issues.

step3.title: Repair & Component Replacement
step3.description: Certified experts repair or replace faulty components using genuine parts.

step4.title: Quality Testing & Verification
step4.description: Every device undergoes rigorous testing to ensure optimal performance before return.

step5.title: Device Return & Warranty
step5.description: Collect your fully serviced device with warranty coverage and ongoing support.

getInTouch.heading: Get in Touch
getInTouch.intro: Our expert team is ready to help with any electronics service or repair request. Reach out and we'll respond within 24 hours.
